subject: general
question:
Select the option that correctly rectifies the underlined spelling error in the given sentence.

The reorganisation of daily life wrought by industrialisation had effects that weakened the material basis for the __instituetions__ of the family and the community.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"institutions"** refers to established organizations or foundations, especially those dedicated to education, public service, or culture. (संस्थाएँ)

 
 
• **Example:** Universities and hospitals are examples of institutions that serve society.
 
 
 
• The incorrectly spelled word **"instituetions"** does not exist in standard English. It is simply a typographical error and should be replaced with the correct spelling **"institutions"**. (संस्थाएँ)
 
 
• **Example:** Institutions play a crucial role in shaping the values and norms of a society.
 
 
 
• Hence, the correct spelling is **"institutions"**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings:

 
• **Option 1: instituteion** (गलत शब्द): This is an incorrect spelling of "institutions".

 
 
• **Example:** This word does not exist in English.
 
 
 
• **Option 2: insteutions** (गलत शब्द): Another incorrect spelling of "institutions".
 
 
• **Example:** This word is not recognized in standard English.
 
 
 
• **Option 3: insteletuons** (गलत शब्द): This is also an incorrect spelling of "institutions".
 
 
• **Example:** This word does not exist in English.
